description: This file defines a TypeScript type for role recommendations and a prompt-building function for guiding an LLM (like Claude) to generate direct role recommendations based on a persona JSON. It is used to create structured prompts for career mobility suggestions.

methods.name: buildClaudeDirectRoleRecommendationsPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a detailed prompt string for an LLM to generate career role recommendations based on a given persona JSON and optional saved target role.
